limitations: Current surviving first-wave cohort, not historical universe membership. Class and overlap history is not certified; retrospective diagnostic only.
Audited adjusted prices are revised histories, not certified publication vintages; audited raw dollar volume is not tape-certified.
Use the pinned October 12 cutoff for comparability; this is not a claim that current app prices end there.
BWX listing hold and CPER unsupported raw-volume observation remain excluded; all 52 candidates are accounted for.
Simple momentum and risk-normalization parameters are declared design choices informed by prior research, not untouched out-of-sample hypotheses.
The new construction omits FR25 overlays, so its gate is not a matched FR25 performance comparison. Existing SOTA results remain the later replay hurdle.
Target-change costs omit held-weight drift and fills; old mapping calibration is not assumed to certify new dynamic-policy turnover.
No NAV, Sharpe, drawdown, achievable execution advantage, alpha discovery or prospective evidence is claimed by this screen.
No FX, macro, historical spreads or fill inputs are used. Unresolved FX and historical membership block broader promotion claims.
